obligations.requirement: Account metadata and handle resolve actual invocation AccountInfo objects and aliases. Retain clone/release order and Rc overflow/abort semantics when adapting raw frames. No synthetic signature flags.
Ref/RefMut use the actual shared borrow state; account metadata remains live through CPI. Borrow errors vs unwrap/panic sites must remain distinct.
Real Rent/syscalls/invoke_signed; actual System implementation, privilege checking and PDA signer derivation. Exact CPI wire/meta/info/seeds are supplied by source.

IdlError retains code/name attachment/origin/compared keys/values and syscall return word. Implement N09 Failure::Idl reporting and original286/290 rich representation/lowering without dropping fields; allocator/formatter heap identity unproved.

Natural prefix decoder/header stream implements application outcomes with valid allocation and 64-bit slices. W77 allocation-before-exhaustion/OOM/destructors, original panic text/coordinates and Rc clone limits are not reproduced by Rust textual similarity.
Source follows checked overhead/multiply, f64 arithmetic and saturating cast. Exact selected compiler soft-float/helper identity is not established; no version guessed.
